verdict.rationale: Browser Use publishes its own OpenAPI 3.1 specs (v2/v3/v4) listed in llms.txt, and its docs include code examples such as client.runs.create. That supports a first-party API reference, but nothing shows the reference is interactive or that the examples run in place. The 404s at the standard OpenAPI paths only mean the spec lives at a non-standard location, not that it is missing. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer or try-it console, runnable in-browser examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
